question: How was that video actually made?

hook_visual.intent: a video taken apart shot by shot into a remake plan

points.claim: rea-video takes any video and tells you shot by shot how the visuals, text, editing and audio were made.
points.spoken: It's rea-video, and it does video reverse engineering: give it any clip and it tells you shot by shot how it was made.
points.source_note: README: 'give it any of them, and it tells you shot by shot how the visuals, styled text, editing and audio were made, then gives you a plan to make one yourself.'

visual.intent: one video opening into a shot list

points.title: Every shot, explained

points.claim: It handles live footage, AI video, avatars, 3D, code motion and mixed edits, judging each shot and reassembling it on the original timeline.
points.spoken: Live footage, AI video, avatars, animation and code-built motion all get judged separately, then put back on the original timeline.
points.source_note: README table: 'Live footage', 'AI video', 'Avatar', '3D / animation', 'Code / template', 'Mixed / edits | Each shot judged separately, then reassembled on the original timeline.'

visual.intent: shot types judged one by one, then put back on the timeline

points.title: One timeline, many kinds
points.sub: Each shot judged on its own.

points.claim: Every shot gets evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt, and the captions, cuts and beats the edit was built on.
points.spoken: Every shot gets evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt, and the captions, cuts and beats it was cut to.
points.source_note: README: 'a full report.html with per-shot frames, evidence, prompts, camera and lighting notes, and the audio breakdown'; 'Captions and styled text: start and end of each line'; 'Editing: where the cuts are, how fast, whether they hit the beat'.

visual.intent: a shot report with the evidence and the rebuilt prompt

points.title: Evidence, then prompts
points.sub: Caption timing and cut points included.

points.claim: The output is a remake plan split into what to film, what to generate and what to code.
points.spoken: Then you get a remake plan split into what to film, what to generate and what to code.
points.source_note: README: 'a remake plan, split into what to film, what to generate and what to code'.

points.title: Film, generate, code
points.sub: A remake plan you can follow.

catch: The catch: the detailed docs are in Chinese for now, and a video model makes the AI calls more accurate.
catch_sub: Your agent reads the docs and answers in English.

catch_visual.intent: the Chinese docs, the optional video model, and the tools it needs
